description: Look up an EU company by VAT or enterprise number in the EU VIES register, Belgian KBO/BCE included: name, VAT id, address, status. 2 credits (EUR 0.02) per successful call; needs a bearer token.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the issuing EU member state (uppercase), e.g. BE, NL, DE, FR.

vatNumber.description: EU VAT number, with or without its country prefix — e.g. "BE0123456789", "NL855876323B01", "DE811569869" or the bare Belgian enterprise number "0123456789".

name: kbo_company_search
